firm_data.firm_description: Ansanelli Law Group, LLP provides the highest standards of elder law, estate planning, and litigation services. Leveraging the intrinsic teamwork and multi-disciplined expertise of our attorneys, we develop creative, practical and effective solutions that fully address our clients’ unique needs.
notable_facts: Leader in Elder Law Firms of Long Island
Provides legal services in elder law, estate planning, estate administration and planning, and health care facility representation in Nassau and Suffolk, New York.

email.subject: AI for Ansanelli Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Vincent,

Since 1987, Ansanelli has built a reputation as a leader in elder law on Long Island, delivering creative solutions across estate planning, litigation, and complex family matters. That depth of expertise is exactly what we see in the 7-attorney practices that outcompete much larger firms.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping practices like yours compete with bigger players.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
